name: [PATCH UPD] Animator Battlegrounds
desc:
Battle with high-energy, stickman-animated characters in a fast-paced multiverse showdown!

⭐ Make sure to Favorite and Upvote to support the project!
📢 Join our Community Server to stay updated and share feedback!

🕹 Controls:
M1 / Click – Punch
F (Hold) – Block
G – Awakening
Q + Direction – Dash
1, 2, 3, 4 – Skills

Down-slam – Jump before the final punch
Uppercut – Hold Jump before the final punch

- ABG, Animation Battlegrounds
